summary_brief: 今日 (2026-01-16) 发现 8 个 Commit 信号，13 个 Release 信号。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent 协作模式
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex 引入 'collab tools' 和 'agent roles'，标志着 AI 编程工具从单一助手向多智能体协作系统演进，提升了处理复杂任务的能力。

engineering_signals.title: 技能系统标准化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex 支持 `SKILL.toml`，Gemini CLI 引入 `frontmatter` 解析，表明行业正在推动 AI 技能/插件的配置标准化，降低了定制门槛。

engineering_signals.title: 安全沙箱与隔离
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex 深度集成 Linux Landlock 和 User Namespaces，显示 AI Agent 在执行代码时对系统安全隔离的极高要求，是 Agent 落地生产的关键。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 工具生态扩展
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude-Flow 宣称集成 175+ MCP 工具，且多个项目（OpenCode, Continue）在优化 MCP 服务器的超时和权限处理，证明 MCP 正成为 AI 工具调用的标准协议。

engineering_signals.title: 本地化模型支持
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Cline 新增对 SAP AI Core 和 Claude 4.5 Haiku 的支持，反映了 AI 编程工具正积极适配企业级私有部署和更小/更快的模型。

engineering_signals.title: 流式输出与 UI 优化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Zed 和 OpenCode 都在大量修复流式渲染、CJK 字符换行和 UI 响应问题，说明提升用户感知的响应速度和稳定性是当前竞争焦点。

research_signals.title: 模型推理能力控制
research_signals.why_it_matters: OpenCode 引入 `reasoningEffort` 参数，允许动态调整模型的推理深度，这为平衡成本与质量提供了细粒度控制，是推理模型应用的重要趋势。

research_signals.title: Agent 评估与测试
research_signals.why_it_matters: LangChain DeepAgents 添加了针对摘要任务的 'mini eval'，显示社区正在从单纯开发转向建立标准化的 Agent 能力评估体系。

releases.author: laipz8200
releases.summary:
## 🔒 Security

Dify now requires Node.js 24.13.0 to pick up the upstream fix for the AsyncLocalStorage/async_hooks DoS CVE that can crash apps with deeply nested input. **All self-hosted deployments should upgrade Node.js**. Thanks to @hyoban in #30945.

Related: #30935.

## 🛠️ Bug Fixes

- **Redirect After Login**: We’ve sorted out the login redirects to bring you back to your intended destination smoothly after logging in. Shoutout to @hyoban for this fix in #30985.
  
- **Missing ID and Message ID**: Missing the essentials? Not anymore! We’ve patched the missing `id` and `message_id` issue, thanks to @fatelei in #31008.

- **Destructuring Undefined Properties**: Ever run into that annoying error where you can't destructure `name` from `value` because it's undefined? That’s been crushed too, all thanks to @fatelei in #30991.

---

## Upgrade Guide

### Docker Compose Deployments

1. Back up your customized docker-compose YAML file (optional)

   ```bash
   cd docker
   cp docker-compose.yaml docker-compose.yaml.$(date +%s).bak
   ```

2. Get the latest code from the main branch

   ```bash
   git checkout main
   git pull origin main
   ```

3. Stop the service. Please execute in the docker directory

   ```bash
   docker compose down
   ```

4. Back up data

   ```bash
   tar -cvf volumes-$(date +%s).tgz volumes
   ```

5. Upgrade services

   ```bash
   docker compose up -d
   ```

> [!NOTE]
> 
> If you encounter errors like below
> 
> ```bash
> 2025/11/26 11:37:57 /app/internal/db/pg/pg.go:30
> [error] failed to initialize database, got error failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=dify_plugin`: hostname resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> 
> 2025/11/26 11:37:57 /app/internal/db/pg/pg.go:34
> [error] failed to initialize database, got error failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=postgres`: hostname > resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> 2025/11/26 11:37:57 init.go:99: [PANIC]failed to init dify plugin db: failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=postgres`: hostname resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> panic: [PANIC]failed to init dify plugin db: failed to connect to `host=db_postgres user=postgres database=postgres`: hostname resolving error (lookup db_postgres on 127.0.0.11:53: server misbehaving)
> ```
> Please use the following command instead. For details, please read this https://github.com/langgenius/dify/issues/28706
>    ```bash
>    docker compose --profile postgresql up -d
>    ```

### Source Code Deployments

1. Stop the API server, Worker, and Web frontend Server.

2. Get the latest code from the release branch:

   ```bash
   git checkout 1.11.4
   ```

3. Update Python dependencies:

   ```bash
   cd api
   uv sync
   ```

4. Then, let's run the migration script:

   ```bash
   uv run flask db upgrade
   ```

5. Finally, run the API server, Worker, and Web frontend Server again.

---

## What's Changed

- fix: redirect after login by @hyoban in https://github.com/langgenius/dify/pull/30985
- fix: fix missing id and message_id by @fatelei in https://github.com/langgenius/dify/pull/31008
- build: require node 24.13.0 by @hyoban in https://github.com/langgenius/dify/pull/30945
- chore: bump version to 1.11.4 by @laipz8200 in https://github.com/langgenius/dify/pull/30961
- fix: fix Cannot destructure property 'name' of 'value' as it is undef… by @hyoban in https://github.com/langgenius/dify/pull/30991

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/langgenius/dify/compare/1.11.3...1.11.4

key_changes: 安全修复：升级 Node.js 到 24.13.0 版本，修复 AsyncLocalStorage/async_hooks DoS CVE 漏洞（可导致深层嵌套输入使应用崩溃），所有自托管部署必须升级
修复登录后重定向问题，确保登录后能正确跳转到目标页面
修复缺失 id 和 message_id 字段的问题
修复解构 undefined 属性导致的错误（无法从 value 中解构 name）
ai_summary.summary_cn: Dify 1.11.4 版本主要包含重要的安全修复，要求所有自托管部署必须将 Node.js 升级到 24.13.0 以修复上游的 AsyncLocalStorage/async_hooks DoS CVE 漏洞。此外还修复了登录后重定向、缺失 ID 字段、解构 undefined 属性等多个 bug 问题。

releases.summary:
## New Features
- App-server v2 now emits collaboration tool calls as item events in the turn stream, so clients can render agent coordination in real time. (#9213)
- Collaboration tools gained richer agent control: `spawn_agent` accepts an agent role preset, and `send_input` can optionally interrupt a running agent before delivering the message. (#9275, #9276)
- `/models` metadata now includes upgrade migration markdown so clients can display richer guidance when suggesting model upgrades. (#9219)

## Bug Fixes
- [revert] Linux sandboxing now falls back to Landlock-only restrictions when user namespaces are unavailable, and sets `no_new_privs` before applying sandbox rules. (#9250)
- `codex resume --last` now respects the current working directory, with `--all` as an explicit override. (#9245)
- Stdin prompt decoding now handles BOMs/UTF-16 and provides clearer errors for invalid encodings. (#9151)

## Changelog

Full Changelog: https://github.com/openai/codex/compare/rust-v0.84.0...rust-v0.85.0

- #9219 Add `migration_markdown` in `model_info` @aibrahim-oai
- #9250 fix: fallback to Landlock-only when user namespaces unavailable and set PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS early @viyatb-oai
- #9213 feat: collab tools app-server event mapping @jif-oai
- #9275 feat: add agent roles to collab tools @jif-oai
- #9276 feat: add interrupt capabilities to `send_input` @jif-oai
- #9209 feat: basic tui for event emission @jif-oai
- #9245 Changed `codex resume --last` to honor the current cwd @etraut-openai
- #9207 Propagate MCP disabled reason @gt-oai
- #9151 fix(exec): improve stdin prompt decoding @liqiongyu
- #9300 revert: remove pre-Landlock bind mounts apply @viyatb-oai

key_changes: App-server v2 现在将协作工具调用作为事件发送，支持实时渲染代理协调
协作工具增强：spawn_agent 支持角色预设，send_input 可中断运行中的代理
/models 元数据新增升级迁移 Markdown，提供更丰富的模型升级指导
Linux 沙箱改进：当用户命名空间不可用时回退到 Landlock 限制
修复 codex resume --last 现在遵循当前工作目录
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此次更新主要增强了协作工具的实时性和控制能力，App-server v2 现在支持实时渲染代理协调，同时 spawn_agent 和 send_input 功能得到增强。此外，改进了模型升级指导和 Linux 沙箱的兼容性，并修复了多个命令行工具的问题。
